chunks: Whoever performs five hajj pilgrimages, Allah will never punish him; and whoever performs ten hajj pilgrimages, Allah will never call him to account; and whoever performs twenty pilgrimages will not see Hell, nor hear its roaring or its exhalation.
ai.seo_question: What reward is mentioned for performing hajj multiple times?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense spiritual merit of repeatedly performing hajj. It describes escalating rewards in the Hereafter, including protection from punishment, freedom from reckoning, and distance from Hellfire.
